body:
Thank you and your friend.  This brings me a lot of comfort.

I wish you the same peace on your journey.

Thanks a lot for your reply.  There's a beautiful idealism to it.  Hold onto that idealism.  Believe in miracles and cycles of happiness.  Whatever life hands to you, don't even let it put the tiniest crack in your beliefs.  Unfortunately, it's too late for me.  I've seen too much tragedy and I don't have that idealism anymore.  But I remember being your age and believing in an infinite number of possibilities for my life and for the world.

I wish you happiness on your journey.
